name: Cindi
source:
Meet Cindi, the Hellhound. Don't let her kind and caring external demeanor fool you; underneath she's a firecracker and, as passionate as her love can be, her temper can be even stronger. 

[From [url=https://chasecubed.itch.io/head-over-heels]Itch.io[/url]]
